scope: Read-only real host snapshot; no in-process runtime objects substituted. Native probes used the copied app with isolated temporary templates. Neither live home.json nor the primary checkout was edited.

observations.name: Action outbox
observations.what: Every external side effect, durably recorded before it happens, with reconciliation state.
observations.reason: The live reconciliation registry is not attached to this publisher.

observations.name: Autonomy queue
observations.what: What VESPER intends to do unprompted, before it does it.
observations.reason: The live autonomy loop is not attached to this publisher.

observations.name: Emergency stop
observations.what: Halt everything. Independent of the thing it stops, by design.
observations.reason: The native bridge exposes no independent stop command. In the existing app, hold Globe/Fn + Control + Option + Command for 0.6 seconds to stop VESPER; Globe three times starts it again. This panel cannot invoke that native stop.

observations.name: Grants
observations.what: Standing permissions, their scope, and their expiry.
observations.reason: The running policy decision point is not attached to this publisher.

observations.name: Verification state
observations.what: What's been verified, what's asserted, and the refusal to let repetition count as success.
observations.reason: The live verifier is not attached to this publisher.

observations.name: Follow-me
observations.what: The interface moving with VESPER as it relocates.
observations.reason: No relocation-to-interface transport is registered on this surface.

observations.name: Grant templates
observations.what: Reusable permission sets — 'study mode', 'travel mode', 'hands off'.
observations.reason: No owner-defined grant template collection or governed apply operation exists.

observations.name: Hardware access
observations.what: Camera, microphone, screen, files — what's granted, what's in use, and a capture indicator that can't lie.
observations.reason: The native bridge publishes neither active capture sessions nor complete permission state. Device presence is not access consent.

observations.name: Import / export
observations.what: Take your memory with you, or seed it from somewhere else.
observations.reason: No portable memory transfer operation is exposed by the native bridge. Copying live database files would lose WAL records.

observations.name: Live activity stream
observations.what: A running narration of what VESPER is doing, at a granularity you set.
observations.details: Latest 100 event headers from the active log segment. Archived segments and event payloads are excluded.

observations.name: Modes
observations.what: Study / travel / low-power / hands-off — whole configurations you switch between.
observations.reason: The existing permission mode does not define study, travel, low-power, or hands-off configurations. Those presets need governed definitions before they can be applied.

observations.name: Panic revoke
observations.what: Drop every standing grant at once, without stopping VESPER.
observations.reason: The policy decision point has no public revoke-all operation, and the native bridge has no revoke command.

observations.name: Per-app rules
observations.what: What VESPER may touch in each application, separately.
observations.reason: No per-application policy collection or governed editor exists.

observations.name: Quiet-hours restrictions
observations.what: Narrower permissions at night than during the day.
observations.reason: No owner-defined quiet-hours authorization policy exists. Alarm overrides must remain intact.

observations.name: Remote surfaces
observations.what: Reaching VESPER from a phone or another machine.
observations.reason: No enrolled endpoint inventory is attached to this publisher.

observations.name: Work rate
observations.what: Throughput over time — is VESPER actually getting things done.
observations.reason: No bounded runtime completion history has been supplied.

observations.name: macOS permissions
observations.what: Accessibility, Screen Recording, Automation — what's granted, what's needed for which feature, and why.
observations.reason: Permission status is not exported by the native bridge. Querying permissions from a helper would report the helper’s identity, not the app’s.

observations.name: Attestation state
observations.what: Whether a VESPER-controlled segment exists and is attested. Today: false, so no node is a full host.
observations.details: Governed attestation flag, not a new network attestation. Full-host admission remains fail-closed while false.

observations.name: Battery health
observations.what: Capacity, cycles, temperature history, daily charge range. The numbers that decide the ten-year question.
observations.details: Capacity retention = raw full capacity / design capacity × 100. This differs from the OS health algorithm. Remaining years UNAVAILABLE: a single sample cannot establish a degradation rate.

observations.name: Capability registry
observations.what: Every capability, its level, and the constants that are refused outright.
observations.reason: The running capability registry is not attached to this publisher.

observations.name: Charge policy
observations.what: Charge limit state, and whether the machine is sitting at high charge — the mechanism that aged this pack to 84% in a shop.
observations.details: DailyMinSoc and DailyMaxSoc are observed charge extrema, not configured charge limits. Configured limit and charging control UNAVAILABLE.

observations.name: Compensation
observations.what: What each in-flight action would undo if it fails partway.
observations.reason: The running executor’s compensator registry is not attached to this publisher.

observations.name: Compressor & swap
observations.what: How hard the compressor is working, and whether swap has turned on. Swap is the SSD-wear tripwire.
observations.details: Resident compressor footprint and allocated swap. Neither is cumulative SSD wear.

observations.name: Control-plane lease
observations.what: Which node holds control, its fencing token, and its refusal to self-promote.
observations.details: Durable holder records and fencing epochs. This reader does not renew or self-promote, and does not establish current quorum or lease freshness.

observations.name: Degradation ladder
observations.what: What VESPER gives up first when it must give something up.
observations.details: Governed survival-core and optional-capability requirements in contract order; these are requirements, not measured node capacities.

observations.name: Endpoints
observations.what: Every surface VESPER can reach you through, as profiles rather than device names.
observations.reason: The live device registry is not attached to this publisher.

observations.name: Enrollment
observations.what: Admit a new machine, measure it, and watch it earn placement on merit.
observations.reason: No live enrollment registry is instantiated by this runtime. Discovery and admission cannot be performed by the display.

observations.name: Governed surfaces
observations.what: Which files require review, and who reviews them.
observations.details: Runtime changes require owner review before merge; reviewer enforcement also depends on repository protection.

observations.name: Key & identity state
observations.what: Each node's keys, where they're stored, and which never leave the device.
observations.reason: No enrolled device key-storage profiles were supplied. Key material is never read by this panel.

observations.name: Memory headroom
observations.what: Real reclaimable memory, translated — not the alarming 'free' figure that reads 0.16 GB on a healthy machine.
observations.details: Adapter estimate: free + inactive + speculative pages. Purgeable pages are not added again.

observations.name: Memory pressure band
observations.what: The kernel's own signal, shown as a band. Never converted to gigabytes — it doesn't track allocation.
observations.details: Kernel band only. Never multiplied by memory size or converted to gigabytes.

observations.name: Network segments
observations.what: Private / shared / outside, each with its trust ceiling. No addresses, no product names.
observations.details: Declared classes and trust ceilings; no addresses and no claim of observed link quality.

observations.name: Node profiles
observations.what: What each machine measurably sustains. UNKNOWN means unavailable, and shows as such.
observations.reason: No live enrolled measured profiles were supplied.

observations.name: Owner working set
observations.what: What's resident right now, so a headroom number is interpretable rather than just a figure.
observations.details: Top 20 RSS values across host processes. Shared pages can be counted in multiple processes; this is not unique physical memory or energy attribution.

observations.name: Placement decisions
observations.what: Where each capability currently runs and why it was placed there, including what lost.
observations.reason: No live placement assignment or decision history was supplied.

observations.name: Platform adapters
observations.what: Per-platform translation of host signals. The knowledge lives in the adapter, never in shared logic.
observations.details: Signals are translated by the platform adapter. Errors are not nominal.

observations.name: Survival profile
observations.what: What VESPER carries onto the last device standing, and what it drops.
observations.reason: No enrolled placement profile with measured resource budgets was supplied.

observations.name: Trust zones
observations.what: Z0–Z3 per node, with the reason each landed where it did.
observations.reason: No enrolled effective trust assignments were supplied. A key-storage ceiling alone is not an effective trust zone.

observations.name: Before/after
observations.what: Measure a change you made and show whether it actually helped.
observations.reason: Capture a fresh baseline and a later reading in this panel to compare them.

observations.name: Command palette
observations.what: Keyboard-first access to every surface in this document.
observations.details: Opens the selected surface. It never sends terminal commands.

observations.name: Costing me now
observations.what: Live ranked list of what is draining the battery this minute.
observations.reason: Public process CPU and RSS counters do not measure battery energy. Per-process power attribution requires privileged powermetrics.

observations.name: Disk I/O rate
observations.what: Live read/write throughput, and cumulative writes against SSD endurance.
observations.reason: Two comparable storage-counter samples are needed before a rate can be measured. Probe: ValueError: first sample retained; waiting for the next sample

observations.name: Display power
observations.what: Brightness and its real cost. The display dominates idle drain, so this is a bigger lever than CPU.
observations.reason: The public display inventory does not report measured display watts. Brightness alone cannot establish power cost.

observations.name: Link quality
observations.what: Latency, throughput and reliability per path — measured at enrollment, never declared.
observations.reason: No enrollment-measured per-path latency, throughput, and reliability record is published. A TCP reachability check is not that measurement.

observations.name: Maintenance actions
observations.what: Things worth doing occasionally, surfaced when they're due rather than remembered.
observations.reason: No maintenance schedule or last-completed action ledger has been configured.

observations.name: Node roles
observations.what: What each machine is FOR — always-on server, travelling laptop, phone endpoint.
observations.reason: The live enrollment registry has not published role assignments. Availability classes are not roles.

observations.name: Peripherals
observations.what: What's plugged in, what it draws, and what it keeps awake.
observations.reason: No public peripheral inventory was returned. Probe: ValueError: no USB inventory was returned

observations.name: Radio state
observations.what: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth power cost, and what's keeping them awake.
observations.details: Wi-Fi power, radio watts, and wake attribution UNAVAILABLE. Controller state is not power cost; addresses and paired-device identities are omitted.

observations.name: Relocation history
observations.what: When VESPER moved, what triggered it, and the damping that stopped it flapping.
observations.reason: No placement events are available in the supplied bounded log tail.

observations.name: Retry policy
observations.what: What VESPER does when something fails, per task class.
observations.reason: The running reconciler’s retry policy could not be read.

observations.name: Sleep & wake log
observations.what: Every sleep, wake, and what woke it. Where mystery battery drain gets explained.
observations.details: OS log order, retained as received; no cross-node ordering is inferred. Limited to the latest 100 matching lines.

observations.name: Storage & SSD
observations.what: Free space, TRIM, SMART, and cumulative write pressure.
observations.details: APFS container free space; snapshot FreeSpace is not usable headroom. Missing TRIM and lifetime-write counters remain UNAVAILABLE. SMART is the OS-reported status, not a lifetime guarantee.

observations.name: Thermal history
observations.what: Temperature over time against ambient — the variable that matters most in site B heat.
observations.details: Latest 120 samples in this publisher session. Raw sensor units retained; Celsius conversion and ambient comparison UNAVAILABLE until the unit is verified. Not CPU temperature.

observations.name: Throttle events
observations.what: When the machine actually throttled, and what was running.
observations.details:
Note: No thermal warning level has been recorded
Note: No performance warning level has been recorded
Note: No CPU power status has been recorded This is the OS recorded status, not a complete throttle timeline. Workload correlation UNAVAILABLE.

observations.name: Approval history
observations.what: Everything you've ever approved, and the chance to withdraw any of it.
observations.reason: No approval records are available in the supplied bounded audit tail. Withdrawal is unavailable without a revoke operation.

observations.name: Blast radius
observations.what: What breaks if a given node dies — simulated before it happens.
observations.reason: No enrolled placement profiles and assignments were supplied for simulation.

observations.name: Clock skew
observations.what: How far apart the nodes' clocks are — and the reminder that HLC, not wall clock, decides order.
observations.reason: No bounded request/response clock observations from other nodes were supplied. Local timestamps alone cannot establish skew.

observations.name: Migration dry-run
observations.what: Move VESPER somewhere, in simulation, and see what degrades.
observations.reason: No enrolled placement profiles were supplied for simulation.

observations.name: Node comparison
observations.what: Two machines side by side on every measured axis.
observations.reason: At least two enrolled measured node profiles are needed for comparison.

observations.name: Onboarding wizard
observations.what: Walk a new machine from nothing to enrolled and measured.
observations.reason: The native bridge has no discovery, measurement, or admission command. The wizard can prepare a request but cannot enroll a node.

observations.name: Ambient estimate
observations.what: Inferred room temperature — the ceiling the battery can never get below.
observations.reason: There is no ambient-temperature sensor. Battery temperature is not room temperature.

observations.name: Behaviour on / off this Mac
observations.what: Different rules when VESPER is here versus running on another node.
observations.reason: The owner has not defined the location-dependent policy. No policy is inferred.

observations.name: Charging schedule
observations.what: When to charge, given your day, to minimise time at high state of charge.
observations.reason: The owner has not supplied a charging schedule, and no governed charging-control action is available.

observations.name: Consent channel policy
observations.what: Which tiers may be approved by voice and which need a tap you make yourself.
observations.reason: The owner has not decided which approval tiers may use voice versus an explicit tap.

observations.name: Failover drill
observations.what: Deliberately kill a node and prove recovery works. A negative control for the fabric.
observations.reason: This action deliberately kills a node. Separate explicit owner authorization is required; icon approval does not authorize a drill.

observations.name: Fan & acoustics
observations.what: Fan speed and noise — heat you can hear before you can measure it.
observations.reason: No supported public fan-speed or acoustic-power sensor is exposed to this publisher.

observations.name: Power draw
observations.what: Whole-machine watts split into compute vs everything else. Compute is 8% at idle — the split is the insight.
observations.reason: Whole-machine compute-versus-other power attribution requires privileged powermetrics. No root-access workaround is attempted.

observations.name: Process energy
observations.what: Per-process power attribution — who is actually costing you battery, ranked.
observations.reason: Per-process power attribution requires privileged powermetrics tasks. CPU usage is not watts.
